name: Ravion
long_description:
Ravion is the agent-native cloud infrastructure platform for AWS.

It gives developers, AI agents, and DevOps one governed place to provision, deploy, and operate applications in their own AWS account.

Get production-grade AWS without building every DevOps capability yourself. Start with production-ready modules and pipelines, bring existing infrastructure, customize the system, and adopt Ravion incrementally as your needs grow.

Ravion connects infrastructure, deployments, failures, logs, and metrics without taking away AWS ownership or native access.
one_liner: The agent-native cloud infrastructure platform for AWS.
